verdict.rationale: Backup and restore is a fair question for a database product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents snapshots, backups, or restore for HelixDB collections. Adjacent items such as durable text indexes, ACID transactions, object-storage run modes, and CLI database creation do not amount to a snapshot/restore capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can back up collections with snapshots and restore them
